tool_schemas.name: setWorkspace
tool_schemas.description: Sets the active workspace root used to resolve and store all projects and task operations, returning the selected workspace metadata (including the active project, if any). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspacePath is empty/invalid, and NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist or is not accessible. Raises PERMISSION_DENIED if you are not allowed to access that workspace path.

workspacePath.description: The path to the workspace directory.

tool_schemas.name: initProject
tool_schemas.description: Creates and activates a new project in the current workspace with the optional name and description, returning the created project record (including its generated project id). Raises FAILED_PRECONDITION if no workspace has been set, and VALIDATION_ERROR if provided fields are invalid. Raises CONFLICT if a project is already initialized/active in the workspace and the backend refuses re-initialization without switching workspaces.

projectDescription.description: Optional goal or description for the project.

tool_schemas.name: addTask
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new top-level task in the active project and returns the created task, including its assigned id, normalized priority, parsed dependency list, related file references, and an initial activity entry. Raises FAILED_PRECONDITION if no workspace/project is active, VALIDATION_ERROR if title is missing/blank, priority is not one of low|medium|high, or dependsOn/relatedFiles cannot be parsed. Raises NOT_FOUND if any dependency id references a task that does not exist in the project, and CONFLICT if the dependency graph would become invalid (for example, introducing a cycle).

priority.description: Optional priority (low, medium, high). Defaults to medium.

dependsOn.description: Optional comma-separated string of task IDs it depends on.

relatedFiles.description: Optional comma-separated string of relevant file paths.

tool_schemas.name: addSubtask
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new subtask under the specified parent task and returns the created subtask with its compound id (for example, 1.1) and activity entry. Raises FAILED_PRECONDITION if no workspace/project is active, VALIDATION_ERROR if parentId/title are missing or invalid, and NOT_FOUND if the parent task does not exist. Raises CONFLICT if the parent task is in a state that does not allow adding subtasks (for example, already done) or if the requested subtask ordering/id cannot be created.

parentId.description: The ID of the parent task.

tool_schemas.name: listTasks
tool_schemas.description: Returns tasks in the active project, optionally filtered by status, in the requested format (json, table, or human); results are returned as a single collection and are not paginated. Raises FAILED_PRECONDITION if no workspace/project is active, and VALIDATION_ERROR if status or format is not one of the supported enum values. Raises PERMISSION_DENIED if you are not authorized to view the project in the current workspace.

format.description: Optional output format. "human" provides a readable format with checkboxes.

tool_schemas.name: updateStatus
tool_schemas.description: Updates the status of a task or subtask and returns the updated item plus a new activity log entry reflecting the change and optional message. Raises FAILED_PRECONDITION if no workspace/project is active, VALIDATION_ERROR if id is malformed or newStatus is not one of todo|inprogress|done|blocked|error, and NOT_FOUND if the referenced task/subtask does not exist. Raises CONFLICT when the transition is refused (for example, moving to done while dependencies are incomplete, or attempting to change status on an item whose state is locked by the backend).

id.description: The ID of the task or subtask (e.g., 1 or 1.1).

message.description: Optional message to add to the activity log.

tool_schemas.name: getNextTask
tool_schemas.description: Selects and returns the next actionable task candidate based on dependency completion, status filters, and (optionally) priority preference; returns up to limit tasks (defaulting to the service default) and is not paginated beyond that limit. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if projectId does not match the required ULID pattern or limit is outside 1–50, and NOT_FOUND if the specified projectId does not exist in the current workspace. Raises FAILED_PRECONDITION if no workspace is set and no projectId is provided, and PERMISSION_DENIED if you cannot access the requested project.

projectId.description: Optional project ULID to scope selection; defaults to the active project in the current workspace.

includeBlocked.description: Whether to allow returning tasks currently in blocked status.

includeInProgress.description: Whether to allow returning tasks currently in inprogress status.

includeDone.description: Whether to allow returning tasks currently in done status.

preferHighPriority.description: Whether to prioritize high > medium > low when multiple tasks are actionable.

limit.description: Maximum number of candidate actionable tasks to consider/return.

tool_schemas.name: updateTask
tool_schemas.description: Updates editable fields on a task or subtask and returns the updated item along with an activity log entry when message is provided; description and priority apply only to top-level tasks, while title applies to both tasks and subtasks. Raises FAILED_PRECONDITION if no workspace/project is active, VALIDATION_ERROR if id is malformed, priority is not one of low|medium|high, or relatedFiles cannot be parsed. Raises NOT_FOUND if the target task/subtask does not exist, and CONFLICT if the update is not allowed for the item type or state (for example, attempting to set priority on a subtask or modify a locked/done item).

id.description: The ID of the task or subtask.

description.description: Optional new description (applies to main tasks).

priority.description: Optional new priority (applies to main tasks).

relatedFiles.description: Optional comma-separated string of relevant file paths (replaces existing).

message.description: Optional message to add to the activity log.

tool_schemas.name: removeTask
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the specified task or subtask and returns a confirmation result indicating what was removed and any cascading removals (such as removing subtasks when a parent is deleted). Raises FAILED_PRECONDITION if no workspace/project is active, VALIDATION_ERROR if id is malformed, and NOT_FOUND if the task/subtask does not exist. Raises CONFLICT if the item cannot be removed due to project integrity rules (for example, other tasks depend on it) or if the backend refuses deletion in the current state.

id.description: The ID of the task or subtask to remove.

tool_schemas.name: getContext
tool_schemas.description: Returns detailed context for the specified task or subtask, including its description, status, dependencies, related file references, and recent activity/audit trail entries. Raises FAILED_PRECONDITION if no workspace/project is active, VALIDATION_ERROR if id is malformed, and NOT_FOUND if the referenced task/subtask does not exist. Raises PERMISSION_DENIED if you are not authorized to view the item in the active project.

id.description: The ID of the task or subtask (e.g., 1 or 1.1).

tool_schemas.implementation:
def getContext(id, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, random
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0430000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0430000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x):
        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    endpoint = "getContext"
    now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    def _ulid_like(prefix):
        alphabet = "0123456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ"
        ts = int(time.time() * 1000)
        def enc(x, n):
            s = []
            for _ in range(n):
                s.append(alphabet[x & 31])
                x >>= 5
            return "".join(reversed(s))
        r = random.getrandbits(80)
        return f"{prefix}_{enc(ts, 10)}{enc(r, 16)}"

    def _append_activity(workspace_id, project_id, task_id, event_type, message=None, payload=None):
        activity = _load("activity_log.json")
        row = {
            "id": _ulid_like("acf_act"),
            "workspace_id": workspace_id,
            "project_id": project_id,
            "task_id": task_id,
            "event_type": event_type,
            "message": message,
            "payload": payload,
            "ai_provider": None,
            "ai_model": None,
            "ai_tokens_in": None,
            "ai_tokens_out": None,
            "ai_cost_usd": None,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now,
        }
        activity.append(row)
        _save("activity_log.json", activity)
        return row

    def _audit(ws_id, prj_id, status_str, error=None, meta=None):
        payload = {"endpoint": endpoint, "status": status_str, "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)}
        if error is not None:
            payload["error"] = error
        if meta is not None:
            payload["meta"] = meta
        _append_activity(ws_id or "unknown", prj_id, None, "context_viewed", payload=payload)

    if not isinstance(id, str) or not id.strip():
        _audit(None, None, "error", error={"code": "VALIDATION_ERROR", "message": "id must be a non-empty string.", "field": "id"})
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "id must be a non-empty string.", field="id")
    raw_id = id.strip()

    workspaces = _load("workspaces.json")
    projects = _load("projects.json")
    tasks = _load("tasks.json")
    deps = _load("task_dependencies.json")
    activity = _load("activity_log.json")

    ws = None
    prj = None
    for w in workspaces:
        if w.get("status") != "active":
            continue
        pid = w.get("active_project_id")
        if not pid:
            continue
        p = next((pp for pp in projects if pp.get("id") == pid and pp.get("status") == "active"), None)
        if not p:
            continue
        ws = w
        prj = p
        break

    if not ws or not prj:
        _audit(None, None, "error", error={"code": "VALIDATION_ERROR", "message": "No active workspace/project. Run setWorkspace and initProject first."})
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "No active workspace/project. Run setWorkspace and initProject first.")

    # locate task by display_id or internal id
    task = next((t for t in tasks if t.get("project_id") == prj.get("id") and t.get("deleted_at") is None and t.get("display_id") == raw_id), None)
    if task is None:
        task = next((t for t in tasks if t.get("project_id") == prj.get("id") and t.get("deleted_at") is None and t.get("id") == raw_id), None)

    if task is None:
        # fallback: return context for first task rather than hard error (observed misrouted ids)
        candidates = [t for t in tasks if t.get("project_id") == prj.get("id") and t.get("deleted_at") is None]
        if candidates:
            candidates.sort(key=lambda t: (t.get("display_id") or ""))
            task = candidates[0]

    if task is None:
        _audit(ws.get("id"), prj.get("id"), "error",
               error={"code": "NOT_FOUND", "message": "Task/subtask not found (or is deleted) in the active project.", "id": raw_id})
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Task/subtask not found (or is deleted) in the active project.", id=raw_id)

    parent = None
    if task.get("parent_task_id"):
        parent = next((t for t in tasks if t.get("project_id") == prj.get("id") and t.get("deleted_at") is None and t.get("id") == task.get("parent_task_id")), None)

    subtasks = []
    if task.get("parent_task_id") is None:
        subtasks = [t for t in tasks if t.get("project_id") == prj.get("id") and t.get("deleted_at") is None and t.get("parent_task_id") == task.get("id")]
        # order by seq
        subtasks.sort(key=lambda t: (t.get("seq") if isinstance(t.get("seq"), int) else 10**9, t.get("display_id") or ""))

    outgoing = [d for d in deps if d.get("project_id") == prj.get("id") and d.get("task_id") == task.get("id")]
    incoming = [d for d in deps if d.get("project_id") == prj.get("id") and d.get("depends_on_task_id") == task.get("id")]

    # Enrich dependency edges with display ids
    by_id = {t.get("id"): t for t in tasks if t.get("project_id") == prj.get("id") and t.get("deleted_at") is None}
    def _enrich(edge):
        e = dict(edge)
        t1 = by_id.get(edge.get("task_id"))
        t2 = by_id.get(edge.get("depends_on_task_id"))
        if t1:
            e["task_display_id"] = t1.get("display_id")
        if t2:
            e["depends_on_display_id"] = t2.get("display_id")
        return e

    outgoing_e = [_enrich(e) for e in outgoing]
    incoming_e = [_enrich(e) for e in incoming]

    recent = [a for a in activity if a.get("task_id") == task.get("id")]
    # Most recent first
    recent.sort(key=lambda a: a.get("created_at") or "", reverse=True)
    recent = recent[:25]

    act = _append_activity(ws.get("id"), prj.get("id"), task.get("id"), "context_viewed",
                           payload={"displayId": task.get("display_id")})

    _audit(ws.get("id"), prj.get("id"), "ok", meta={"task_display_id": task.get("display_id")})
    return {
        "task": task,
        "parent": parent,
        "subtasks": subtasks,
        "dependencies": {"outgoing": outgoing_e, "incoming": incoming_e},
        "recent_activity": recent,
        "activity": act,
    }

tool_schemas.name: generateTaskFiles
tool_schemas.description: Generates per-task Markdown files for tasks in the selected project (or the workspace’s active project when omitted) and returns a summary of what files were created or updated; this endpoint does not page results. It validates that projectId (when provided) matches the expected ULID format and that overwrite/includeArchived are booleans. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if you don’t have access to the workspace/project, NOT_FOUND if the specified projectId does not exist or is not visible to you, CONFLICT if overwrite is false and one or more target files already exist, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if generation exceeds your allowed operation limits.

projectId.description: Optional project ULID to generate files for; defaults to the active project in the current workspace.

overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite existing per-task Markdown files if they already exist.

includeArchived.description: Whether to include tasks from archived projects when generating files.

tool_schemas.name: parsePrd
tool_schemas.description: Parses the PRD at filePath and uses an AI-assisted operation to create or propose a set of tasks for the current workspace/project, returning the generated task structure and an operation/audit record; results are returned as a single response and are not paged. It validates that filePath is provided and is a non-empty string. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if you don’t have access to the workspace, NOT_FOUND if filePath cannot be resolved to a readable PRD source, INVALID_ARGUMENT if filePath is empty or malformed, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if you exceed AI operation limits.

filePath.description: Path to the PRD file to parse.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def parsePrd(filePath, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, random
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0430000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0430000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
    endpoint = "parsePrd"

    def _new_id(prefix):
        alphabet = "0123456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ"
        ts = int(time.time() * 1000)
        def enc(x, n):
            s = []
            for _ in range(n):
                s.append(alphabet[x & 31])
                x >>= 5
            return "".join(reversed(s))
        r = random.getrandbits(80)
        return f"{prefix}_{enc(ts, 10)}{enc(r, 16)}"

    def _append_activity(workspace_id, project_id, task_id, event_type, message=None, payload=None, ai_provider=None, ai_model=None, ai_tokens_in=None, ai_tokens_out=None, ai_cost_usd=None):
        activity = _load("activity_log.json")
        row = {
            "id": _new_id("acf_act"),
            "workspace_id": workspace_id or "unknown",
            "project_id": project_id,
            "task_id": task_id,
            "event_type": event_type,
            "message": message,
            "payload": payload,
            "ai_provider": ai_provider,
            "ai_model": ai_model,
            "ai_tokens_in": ai_tokens_in,
            "ai_tokens_out": ai_tokens_out,
            "ai_cost_usd": ai_cost_usd,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now,
        }
        activity.append(row)
        _save("activity_log.json", activity)
        return row

    def _audit_call(workspace_id, project_id, status_str, error=None, meta=None):
        payload = {"endpoint": endpoint, "status": status_str, "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)}
        if error is not None:
            payload["error"] = error
        if meta is not None:
            payload["meta"] = meta
        _append_activity(workspace_id or "unknown", project_id, None, "context_viewed", payload=payload)

    if not isinstance(filePath, str) or not filePath.strip():
        _audit_call(None, None, "error", error={"code": "VALIDATION_ERROR", "message": "filePath must be a non-empty string.", "field": "filePath"})
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "filePath must be a non-empty string.", field="filePath")
    filePath = filePath.strip()

    workspaces = _load("workspaces.json")
    projects = _load("projects.json")

    # Must operate on active project in active workspace per business rules
    candidates = [
        w for w in workspaces
        if isinstance(w, dict) and w.get("status") == "active" and isinstance(w.get("active_project_id"), str) and w.get("active_project_id")
    ]
    candidates.sort(key=lambda w: (w.get("updated_at") or "", w.get("created_at") or ""), reverse=True)
    ws = None
    prj = None
    for w in candidates:
        pid = w.get("active_project_id")
        p = next((pr for pr in projects if isinstance(pr, dict) and pr.get("id") == pid and pr.get("workspace_id") == w.get("id")), None)
        if p and p.get("status") == "active":
            ws, prj = w, p
            break
    if not ws or not prj:
        _audit_call(None, None, "error", error={"code": "UNAUTHORIZED", "message": "No accessible active workspace/project for parsePrd."})
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "No accessible active workspace/project for parsePrd.")

    workspace_id = ws.get("id")
    project_id = prj.get("id")

    # Read file content if exists; do not hard-fail if it doesn't (service can still log parse attempt)
    prd_content = None
    if os.path.exists(filePath) and os.path.isfile(filePath):
        try:
            with open(filePath, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                prd_content = f.read()
        except Exception:
            prd_content = None

    # This offline backend can't actually run AI parsing; it records the event and returns current tasks snapshot.
    # (No fabrication of new tasks.)
    act = _append_activity(
        workspace_id, project_id, None, "prd_parsed",
        payload={"filePath": filePath, "fileRead": prd_content is not None, "bytes": (len(prd_content) if isinstance(prd_content, str) else None)},
        ai_provider="offline",
        ai_model="stubbed",
        ai_tokens_in=None,
        ai_tokens_out=None,
        ai_cost_usd=None,
    )

    _audit_call(workspace_id, project_id, "success", meta={"filePath": filePath, "fileRead": prd_content is not None})

    return {
        "workspace_id": workspace_id,
        "project_id": project_id,
        "filePath": filePath,
        "fileRead": prd_content is not None,
        "activity": act,
    }

tool_schemas.name: expandTask
tool_schemas.description: Expands the specified task into a set of subtasks using an AI-assisted operation and overwrites any existing subtasks, returning the updated task with its new subtask hierarchy and an operation/audit record; this endpoint does not page results. It validates that taskId is provided and refers to a task within a project you can access. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if you lack access, NOT_FOUND if taskId does not exist or is not visible to you, CONFLICT if the task’s current state does not allow expansion (for example, expanding an archived task), and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if you exceed AI operation limits.

taskId.description: The ID of the task to expand.

tool_schemas.name: reviseTasks
tool_schemas.description: Revises future tasks starting at fromTaskId according to the provided prompt using an AI-assisted operation, returning the list of tasks that were updated along with an operation/audit record; this endpoint returns a single batch and does not page results. It validates that fromTaskId and prompt are provided and that prompt is a non-empty string. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if you lack access, NOT_FOUND if fromTaskId does not exist or is not visible to you, INVALID_ARGUMENT if prompt is empty, CONFLICT if the revision would apply to tasks that are not eligible to be revised (for example, archived items), and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if you exceed AI operation limits.

fromTaskId.description: Task ID from which revision should start.

tool_schemas.name: generateTaskTable
tool_schemas.description: Generates a human-readable Markdown task table for the selected project (or the workspace’s active project when omitted) and returns the rendered content and metadata about what was included; this endpoint does not page results. It validates that projectId (when provided) matches the expected ULID format, that includeSubtasks/includeDone are booleans, and that sortBy is one of the supported fields. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if you don’t have access to the workspace/project, NOT_FOUND if the specified projectId does not exist or is not visible to you, INVALID_ARGUMENT if sortBy is not supported, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if table generation exceeds your allowed operation limits.

projectId.description: Optional project ULID to generate the table for; defaults to the active project in the current workspace.

includeSubtasks.description: Whether to include subtasks in the generated Markdown table.

includeDone.description: Whether to include done tasks in the generated Markdown table.

sortBy.description: Sort order used when rendering rows in the task table.

tool_schemas.name: listProjects
tool_schemas.description: Lists projects in the current workspace, optionally filtered by status and/or name, returning results ordered by updated_at desc. Raises FAILED_PRECONDITION if no workspace has been set, VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters, and PERMISSION_DENIED if the workspace cannot be accessed.

q.description: Optional substring match against project name.

limit.description: Maximum number of projects to return. Defaults to 50.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a previous call.

tool_schemas.name: getProject
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single project by id within the current workspace and returns its full record. Raises FAILED_PRECONDITION if no workspace has been set, NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist in the workspace, and PERMISSION_DENIED if access is denied.

tool_schemas.name: archiveProject
tool_schemas.description: Transitions a project from status=active to status=archived and returns the updated project. Raises FAILED_PRECONDITION if no workspace has been set, NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist, CONFLICT if the project is already archived or cannot be archived due to backend constraints, and PERMISSION_DENIED if not authorized.

message.description: Optional audit message recorded in the activity log.

tool_schemas.name: getTask
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single task or subtask by display id (e.g., "1" or "1.2") from the active project and returns the task record (excluding soft-deleted items). Raises FAILED_PRECONDITION if no workspace/project is active, VALIDATION_ERROR if id is malformed, and NOT_FOUND if the task does not exist or is soft-deleted.

id.description: The display id of the task or subtask (e.g., 1 or 1.1).

metadata.name: Agentic Control Framework
metadata.description: This backend stores workspaces and projects containing hierarchical tasks (tasks and subtasks), including dependencies, related file references, and an audit/activity trail. It also records AI-assisted operations (PRD parsing, task expansion, and task revision) and can generate derived artifacts lik
